responsibility: This file extends the base MIPS DSP machine description with the DSP ASE Revision 2 instruction set. It adds additional UNSPEC codes and instruction patterns for newer byte/halfword arithmetic, append/balign, comparisons, multiply and packed-accumulator operations, and other DSPr2-specific vector-like integer instructions, so GCC can generate the revision-2 DSP encodings when ISA_HAS_DSPR2 is enabled.
